finding.description: After the new post-IMPORT Attempt waiter returns Ready, the old pre-helper check only reads the watch boolean. A sender disappearing between Ready and that check is not treated as stop, despite the explicit sender-loss contract. The initial pre-wait check already tests has_changed().is_err().
finding.recommendation: Use one private sticky stop predicate including sender disappearance for every existing pre-helper/post-record check, without cancelling accepted helper or commit futures.
